parkedExclusions.reason: SRAC protocol framing — assertions are protocol-specific (adrenochrome-based complexes proposed to suppress NF-kB-driven SASP), not established general biology; conflicts with the pro-inflammatory/redox-active characterization elsewhere in the corpus (see conflict T2-2).
parkedExclusions.reason_zh_TW: SRAC 協定架構——主張屬協定專屬（提議以腎上腺素紅為基礎的複合物抑制 NF-kB 驅動的 SASP），並非普遍生物學；與語料庫其他處的促發炎／氧化還原活性描述相矛盾（見衝突 T2-2）。

scenarios.title: Triples Human-Review — Adrenochrome / Mitohormesis / Autophagy / Sirtuins
scenarios.description: Decision points distilled from the Tier 1–3 triples review report. Pick a stance per conflict and re-run graph analyses against the modified edge set.

conflicts.title: Adrenochrome detectability: never detected vs detected in synovial fluid
conflicts.summary: Direct cross-paper conflict: one source states adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids (central to its controversial clinical significance); another reports detection in rheumatoid synovial fluid. Likely resolution: undetectable systemically in health, detectable locally under high-oxidative inflammatory conditions.

evidence.label: is_undetectable_in
evidence.context: Despite decades of interest in the adrenochrome pathway, adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids, and no established method for its formation in vivo has been demonstrated; this is the central reason the clinical significance of the compound …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 儘管數十年來對 adrenochrome 途徑感興趣，adrenochrome 從未在生物液體中被檢測到，也尚未建立證明其在體內形成的既成方法；這是該化合物臨床意義仍具爭議性的核心原因。檢測的困難與該分子的化學性質一致，包括其在水溶液中的不穩定性與短半衰期、迅速聚合成 melanins，以及對蛋白質和 DNA 的反應性，這些都會阻止其累積。體內形成最強的證據是間接的，例如在富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中檢測到與 adrenochrome 具有相同 HPLC 滯留時間的化合物，以及心肌梗塞後血清中出現氧化酶活性。然而，它明顯不存在於生物液體中，助長了對該途徑是否在人類疾病中真正重要的懷疑。

evidence.label: detected_in
evidence.context: Researchers have detected adrenochrome-like compounds in neutrophil-rich fluids such as synovial fluid from rheumatoid arthritis patients, where neutrophil activation and ROS release are prominent. This suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Researchers已在neutrophil-rich fluids中，例如rheumatoid arthritis患者的synovial fluid，detected adrenochrome-like compounds，此處neutrophil activation與ROS release顯著。這suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine oxidation in inflammatory或stress-related conditions，且有一項study proposed它可能是inflammatory diseases中adrenaline的potential catabolic route。在此類fluids中detected的adrenochrome reflects inflammation部位catecholamines的local oxidation，consistent with the observation that activated neutrophils的cell-free medium retains adrenaline-oxidizing ability。

options.label: Keep both — qualified reading
options.detail: Undetectable systemically; detectable locally under oxidative inflammation. Both edges stay.
options.detail_zh_TW: 全身性無法檢出；局部氧化發炎下可檢出。兩個邊都保留。

options.label: Never detectable
options.detail: Favor the systemic claim; remove the synovial-fluid detection.
options.detail_zh_TW: 採納全身性主張；移除滑液檢出。

options.label: Local detection wins
options.detail: Remove the blanket undetectability claim; keep the synovial-fluid detection.
options.detail_zh_TW: 移除「全面無法檢出」主張；保留滑液檢出。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅的可檢出性：從未檢出 vs 於關節滑液檢出
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 直接的跨文獻矛盾：一篇文獻指出腎上腺素紅從未在生物體液中檢出（這是其臨床意義具爭議性的核心）；另一篇則報告在類風濕性關節炎滑液中檢出。可能的調和解讀：健康狀態下全身體液無法檢出，但在高氧化壓力的發炎環境中可局部檢出。

conflicts.title: Rapamycin and the immune system: suppresses vs reverses immunosenescence
conflicts.summary: Classic conflicting-views case. mTOR inhibition is immunosuppressive (transplant literature) yet improves immune function in aged animals (immunosenescence reversal). Both edges are individually defensible but contradictory without an age-context qualifier. Unresolved, downstream queries return whichever document was traversed last.

evidence.label: suppresses
evidence.source: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
evidence.context: In clinical settings, rapamycin's immunosuppressive mechanisms increase infection risk and impair wound healing, especially in otherwise healthy individuals without clinical manifestations that outweigh the risk of side effects. Some early clinical studies …
evidence.context_zh_TW: 在臨床環境中，rapamycin的免疫抑製機制增加感染風險並損害傷口癒合，特別是在其他方面健康、沒有臨床表現的個體中，其風險超過副作用的風險。一些早期臨床研究表明，短期rapamycin或rapalogs可能改善老年人免疫功能的某些方面，但這些研究依賴於對流感疫苗接種的血清學反應，這對更廣泛的免疫能力的預測價值有限。更廣泛的措施，包括T細胞庫多樣性、先天免疫活性和現實世界的感染抵抗力，仍然研究不足。

evidence.label: delays
evidence.context: Rapamycin delays immune aging by inhibiting mTORC1, an intervention shown to restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance the generation and persistence of memory CD8+ T cells in aged subjects. Mechanistically, mTORC1 inhibition shifts lymphocytes …
evidence.context_zh_TW: Rapamycin透過抑制mTORC1來延緩免疫老化，此介入已被證明可恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強老年個體中記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成與持續。在機制上，mTORC1抑制將淋巴細胞推向更初始、較不耗竭的狀態，並促進免疫細胞內自噬介導的品質控制。在臨床前和臨床研究中，短暫的rapamycin治療改善了老年人對疫苗的免疫反應。這些效應說明了標靶mTOR—自噬軸如何能在功能上使老化的免疫系統恢復年輕。

options.label: Immunostimulatory in aged animals
options.detail: Keep the immunosenescence-reversal edge; remove the systemic immunosuppression edge.
options.label_zh_TW: 對老年動物具免疫刺激性
options.detail_zh_TW: 保留免疫老化逆轉邊；移除全身性免疫抑制邊。

options.label: Immunosuppressive
options.detail: Keep the transplant-context suppression edge; remove the immune-aging edge.
options.detail_zh_TW: 保留移植語境的抑制邊；移除免疫老化邊。

options.label: Keep both — context-dependent
options.detail: The disagreement is the scientifically valuable content: suppression in transplant settings, restoration in aged animals.
options.detail_zh_TW: 矛盾本身正是有價值的科學內容：移植情境下抑制，老年動物中恢復。

conflicts.title_zh_TW: 雷帕霉素與免疫系統：抑制 vs 逆轉免疫老化
conflicts.summary_zh_TW: 經典的觀點衝突案例。mTOR 抑制具免疫抑制作用（移植文獻），但在老年動物中能改善免疫功能（免疫老化逆轉）。兩個邊各自都有依據，但缺少年齡語境限定時相互矛盾。不處理的話，下游查詢會回傳「最後被遍歷到的那份文獻」的說法。

resolvedUpstream.note_zh_TW: NR 改善 vs 無法改善胰島素敏感性——由邊去重解決（fails_to_improve 勝出）。
